section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) involving 1152 Chinese adolescent girls (ages 11-15) recruited from four public schools in Wuhan City, Hubei province. Data were collected via pencil-and-paper survey, with participants providing information on demographics, weight, height, social media use, body image, and eating behaviors. The questionnaire was translated into Chinese and back-translated to English to ensure validity.
